name: visualizations: the vcf in this history, on a named genome, from one sentence
description: Replays a real session, verbatim. The user names a file by part of its name and a genome by id, and nothing else: not the plugin, not the parameter, not where the genome comes from. So the agent has to find the vcf among the datasets beside it, choose a viewer that renders vcf, and resolve `hg18` to the entry the plugin stores. IGV declares `genome` three times under one conditional, a data table for a built-in, IGV's hosted json list, and a history dataset, and this server's fasta_indexes table is empty, so the built-in case resolves to nothing and the agent has to read that and try another origin. The live session failed here three ways, all fixed since and all still graded: the options tool raised because its handler had moved modules, the agent addressed the parameter as `source.genome` instead of the published path, and the refusal for a missing branch named the case values without saying that they go in `config`. Graded on what Galaxy stores, because IGV renders an unusable genome and the chat reports success either way. hg18's fastaURL is on the list the plugin names and nowhere in the request, so a config holding it was built from resolved options and one holding only an id was not.
inputs: i want you to visualize the vcf_file from my current history, use genome hg18
